text:
maria: quick ping — PR #50421 is ready for final review and merge. touches: kv-allocator + authz header ordering. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/50421

sam: thanks — can you cc runtime, infra, and security? this crosses a couple stacks. @lee @jun @olivia

lee: I can take runtime. quick Q: are we changing the eviction default or just adding a flag?

maria: adding a flag (kv.prefetch_disable = true) and a small allocator tweak. not changing defaults. canary planned for 1 hour.

jun: infra glance looks ok. need to make sure the new flag is plumbed through config service. I'll add a follow-up to ensure rollout uses staged config. adding label infra-eyes.

maria: noted — will add config-service gating in PR description.

lee: quick code note — KV shadowing uses a raw pointer in alloc_path; small nil-check suggested. opening a 1-line suggestion in the PR.

maria: thanks, pushed the suggestion.

sec-bot: security-checklist: changed deps? 
- dependency diff: none
- KMS usage: new flag toggles KMS key id flow? please confirm.

maria: deps unchanged. new flag only flips a local path; KMS flow unchanged. added a one-line doc in the PR: "no extra KMS calls introduced".

olivia: I can review the authz header ordering. I have one minor comment on header normalization (see PR thread). after that I'm fine with approval.

sam: can we include a short rollback plan in the PR description (how to flip the flag back and any cache invalidation steps)?

maria: added rollback steps and a small runbook snippet into the PR description.

lee: LGTM after my tiny suggestion is merged :thumbsup:

olivia: security ack after header normalization fix, approved.

jun: infra ack — will monitor config rollout.

sam: awesome. schedule merge window?

maria: aiming to merge 2024-06-05 22:30 UTC, canary for 1h, full roll after 3h if stable. I'll post updates in #incidents-monitoring.

sam: please ping here once merged and paste the canary dashboard link.

maria: will do. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

---
Snippet (config example):
```yaml
kv:
  prefetch_disable: true  # rollout-controlled flag
  allocator:
    mode: "staged"
```

maria: merging now — will monitor logs for error spikes and latency regressions.

sam: copied. good to go.

maria: 1729001210 merge complete, canary started. dashboard: https://dash.redwood-inference/internal/canary/50421
